metadata.description: A research agent kit for Claude Code that pre-registers, gates on controls, and only then believes results.

plugins.name: rak-knowledge
plugins.description: Markdown research knowledge base: add papers from arXiv/DOI, concept cards, cited keyword queries, daily digests, and a static site with a local-only Q&A bridge. (Collision search before a claim lives in rak-discipline.)

plugins.name: rak-discipline
plugins.description: Pre-register, gate with positive/negative controls, judge with a frozen verdict script, correct by erratum, and turn experiment lines into lessons - with hooks that block launches without a frozen prereg, verdicts without a passing gate, and rewrites of committed results.

plugins.name: rak-cloud
plugins.description: Cloud GPU job lifecycle with spending kept outside the agent: pre-create checks, VM-side job state machine, an external waiter that only treats 'not found' as gone, verify-every-file-before-delete, idle self-delete, max-run, a cost ledger, and a local GPU lock.

plugins.name: rak-team
plugins.description: Lead/worker coordination for several Claude Code sessions: dispatch, report-to-lead-before-writing, path-scoped commits, handoff files, and notifications (official Channels first, a Telegram bridge as fallback).
